representative_scale.gpu_model_reason: Brief allows H100, A100 or A10 class; actual stock GPU unknown. Record and hold actual GPU fixed.

energy_series.reason: Driver collects 100 energies per replica but serializes only mean and final. Full trajectory identity cannot be established from supplied JSON alone.

scoring_interface.primary: Read ensemble.json total_wall_s; minimize for fixed work.
scoring_interface.speedup: Baseline total_wall_s / candidate total_wall_s on same GPU.
scoring_interface.scientific_comparison: Match replica and seed, compare final_potential_kj_mol and mean_potential_kj_mol; this cannot establish full series identity.
scoring_interface.missing_evidence_reason: Brief predictions supply no independent fixed-work measurements or numerical energy acceptance criterion; reference throughput has null tolerance.

timing_scope.ensemble_start: After PDB parsing, force-field/system creation and platform lookup; before first integrator/context creation.
timing_scope.ensemble_end: After final context/integrator destruction; before JSON serialization.
includes: Integrator and context creation, including kernel compilation inside this interval
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context/positions/velocity setup; includes integration and energy queries, excludes context setup and teardown.
timing_scope.concurrent_candidate: Measure complete same-work ensemble makespan, including analogous replica setup and teardown; no published candidate driver or timing implementation supplied.

budget_assessment.published_estimate: Brief estimates about one minute on H100 and a few minutes on slower GPUs; estimate is unverified.
budget_assessment.reason: No workload run. Fixed 200000-step total workload selected; no scale search, doubling loop, or toy extrapolation.

unavailable_commands.reason: Brief supplies hypothesis and thread-percentage rule but no fixed-work concurrent driver command; none invented.
